My plot is small, only 0.24 hectares, so I will buy a small amount of subsidized NPK fertilizer to spread on it, but I will use the sorghum seed I saved from last season because improved seed is expensive and hard to find. I will also put some cow manure on the plot because it improves the soil, and my family and I can manage the work ourselves since the farm is not large.
